source_metadata.title: Quinolones and risk of haemolysis in patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency: a nationwide retrospective active-comparator cohort study

extraction_limitations: No supplementary materials were provided with the source PDF.
Atoms reflect claims and results reported in the article; cited studies in the bibliography were not atomized as primary evidence.
The article itself reports incomplete G6PD phenotype/genotype data, selective laboratory testing, and sparse events for some subgroups/agents.
Review status is needs_review because extraction was performed by a language model and has not been independently human-verified.
